pages.text: Goblins inhabit swamps, mangroves, and dark forests. They are hunched, agile, and possess a deep relationship with discarded objects.$(br2)To a goblin, nothing is rubbish.
Never throw something away in front of a goblin. It is considered a moral waste.$(br2)Goblin art — $(italic)unggue$() — is made from recycled materials and is culturally sacred.
